---
title: "Is the project worth funding?"
summary: "A project pays more next year than it costs today. Find the financing rate at which the decision reverses."
base: ..
sectionname: Chapters
kicker: "Chapter 5 · Intertemporal choice"

::: {.decision}
**Your decision.** A firm can pay HK$100,000 today to receive a certain HK$108,000 exactly one year from now. It has to borrow the full cost. Should it accept a one-year loan at 6%? What would you say at 10%?
:::

## Put both choices on the same date

At 6% the firm owes HK$106,000 at maturity. The project leaves **HK$2,000** after repayment. In today’s money that surplus is 2,000 / 1.06 = **HK$1,886.79**. Equivalently, subtract the initial outlay from the present value of the receipt. The two methods agree because they compare the same cash flows on a common date.

| Rate | Loan repayment in one year | Surplus at maturity | Net present value today |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 6% | 106,000 | +2,000 | +1,886.79 |
| 8% | 108,000 | 0 | 0 |
| 10% | 110,000 | −2,000 | −1,818.18 |

The switch occurs at 108,000 / 100,000 − 1 = **8%**. This comparison assumes certain payment, no fees or taxes, and a single drawdown with one repayment. If the receipt were risky, its promised amount and a borrowing quote alone would be insufficient to value the project.

## Read the household budget line

Suppose a household starts with 100 units of income today and 50 next year. It can lend or borrow at 6%. If it consumes 80 today, it saves 20 and can consume 50 + 20 × 1.06 = **71.2** next year. If it consumes 120 today, it borrows 20 and has **28.8** left next year. Each extra unit consumed today costs 1.06 units next year. Preferences determine which affordable pair the household chooses.

<details><summary>What if saving earns 4% while borrowing costs 10%?</summary>
<p>The budget line bends where consumption today equals current income. Consuming 80 today now leaves 50 + 20 × 1.04 = 70.8 next year. Consuming 120 leaves 50 − 20 × 1.10 = 28. A firm with HK$100,000 idle that would otherwise earn 4% gains HK$4,000 at maturity from the project. A firm financing the same project entirely at 10% loses HK$2,000. The source of the marginal dollar changes the decision.</p>
</details>

## Make the financing recommendation

At 6%, accept under the stated assumptions. At 10%, decline. If a lender also charges an up-front fee, deduct it from today’s net present value. A HK$2,000 fee paid from cash today would turn the 6% decision negative. This is why an analyst asks for the drawdown, fee, and repayment dates before comparing two term sheets.

```{=html}
<h2 id="project-appraisal-lab-title">Compare financing fees</h2><p>A HK$100,000 project pays HK$108,000 in one year. What fee can you authorize, and when is it due?</p>
<form><p><label>Annual financing rate (%) <select><option>4</option><option selected>6</option><option>8</option><option>10</option></select></label></p>
<p><label>Fee (HK$) <select><option>0</option><option>1500</option><option>1886.79</option><option selected>2000</option><option>2500</option></select></label></p>
<p><label>Fee due <select><option>Today</option><option selected>At maturity</option></select></label></p><button type="reset">Reset scenario</button></form>
<div aria-live="polite" class="scenario-result"></div>
<details><summary>Check the calculation</summary><p class="scenario-math"></p></details>
<p><strong>Make the call.</strong> Which action would you recommend? Give a figure and the assumption that matters most.</p>

<noscript>Enable JavaScript to change scenarios. The worked example below explains the decision.</noscript>
</section>
<script>
(() => {
  const lab = document.getElementById('project-appraisal-lab');
  const form = lab.querySelector('form');
  const format = n => n.toLocaleString('en-US', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2});
  const money = n => 'HK$' + format(n);
  const usd = n => 'US$' + format(n);
  function calculate(inputs) {
    const [rate,fee,timing]=inputs, factor=1+rate/100;
const before=108000-100000*factor, cap=timing==='Today'?before/factor:before;
const maturity=before-fee*(timing==='Today'?factor:1);
return {rows:[['Year-end surplus after financing the fee',money(maturity)],['Surplus in today’s dollars',money(maturity/factor)],['Break-even fee at chosen date',cap<0?'No nonnegative fee works':money(cap)]],math:'Year-end surplus before fees = HK$108,000 − HK$100,000 × (1 + rate). An upfront fee is financed for the year at that rate.',call:Math.abs(maturity)<0.005?'The project breaks even to the nearest cent. Seek better terms to create value.':maturity>0?'The quoted terms leave a positive surplus. Confirm the receipt and repayment fall on the same day.':'Renegotiate the financing terms. Discounting the fee and receipt to the same date gives a negative surplus.'};
  }
  function refresh() {
    const inputs = Array.from(form.querySelectorAll('select'), field => Number.isFinite(Number(field.value)) ? Number(field.value) : field.value);
    const result = calculate(inputs);
    const table = document.createElement('table');
    table.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scenario results');
    for (const [label, value] of result.rows) {
      const row = table.insertRow();
      const heading = document.createElement('th');
      heading.scope = 'row';
      heading.textContent = label;
      row.append(heading);
      row.insertCell().textContent = value;
    }
    const output = lab.querySelector('.scenario-result');
    output.replaceChildren(table);
    if (result.bars) {
      const maximum = Math.max(...result.bars.map(item => item[1]));
      for (const [label, value] of result.bars) {
        const line = document.createElement('p');
        const bar = document.createElement('meter');
        bar.max = maximum;
        bar.value = value;
        bar.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
        line.append(label + ' ', bar, ' ' + value);
        output.append(line);
      }
    }
    lab.querySelector('.scenario-math').textContent = result.math;
    lab.querySelector('.scenario-call').textContent = result.call;
  }
  form.addEventListener('change', refresh);
  form.addEventListener('reset', () => requestAnimationFrame(refresh));
  refresh();
})();
</script>
<section aria-label="Practice brief"><h2>What borrowing terms would you authorize?</h2><details><summary>Compare your recommendation</summary><p>Authorize the 6% loan if the project still produces a surplus after fees. If the fee is paid today, its break-even amount is HK$1,886.79 at the same financing rate. Ask for the fee amount and payment date before signing.</p></details></section>
```

**Apply the model.** Would the project with the faster payback also win on present value? [FIN-08 · Back sooner. Worth more?](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/back-sooner.html)

**Teaching source.** Week 3 develops the two-period budget and discounting. The project, funding terms, and household figures are illustrative.
